title: Turned down in Paris, then she begs at the red light
description: Nate proposes under the Eiffel Tower and his girlfriend leaves him for a rich older man. His laptop grind becomes trading on fomo, from a red day to a $1,280,000 balance, and two years later she begs from the car next to his hypercar while he sings her off. The live-action tag at the end becomes Nate saying fomo's end line.
text:
SCENE 1 — EXT. EIFFEL TOWER PLAZA — SUNSET
Nate, cap backwards, kneels holding up an open red ring box; the girl stands over him as a crowd films on their phones. She leans down into his face and shouts.
GIRL: Hell no!
Close on Nate, the ring box toward camera: his smile drops, eyes wide.
She turns and walks off. Whip pan to a gold watch on a suited arm, tilt up to the older man; she hugs his arm, Nate small in the crowd behind.
GIRL: I told you I like older men!
A dark luxury car's chrome grille, headlights switching on.
At the open car door, she turns to Nate's face.
GIRL: This is what I wanted.
She gets in; the car pulls away past Nate.
Slow push in on Nate alone with the ring box, all the way to his eye; a tear rolls.
NATE: Just Paris with you.
SCENE 2 — FLASHBACK — EXT. PARIS — SUNSET
Soft pink glow: she cups Nate's face, inches apart; he smiles.
GIRL: I love you, Nate.
GIRL: I'll never leave you.
SCENE 3 — EXT. EIFFEL TOWER PLAZA — SUNSET
The plaza is empty now, the sun flaring behind Nate. He stares at the ring, puts the box in his pocket, and his face hardens.
SCENE 4 — MONTAGE — NATE'S BEDROOM — DAYS AND NIGHTS
Locked-off, frontal: Nate at his desk in a small bedroom, laptop open, phone in hand, the room flickering from night (cold blue glow) to day and back.
★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Nate's phone, a red day
Night: Nate drops his head into his hands, then sits back up and keeps going.
Day: the wall clock jumps on; Nate eats cereal at the desk, eyes never leaving his phone.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, his first small win, the position reads +$38 (+2.7%)
Night: rain on the window, Nate gives a tiny nod and leans in.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $4,960
The day-night flicker speeds up; Nate leans closer each time.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $31,200
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $1,280,000
Punch in on Nate's hard, focused stare.
SCENE 5 — INT. GLASS PENTHOUSE — SUNSET
Nate, in a black suit over a black tee, silver chain and watch, cap backwards, walks in, checks his watch and smirks; the camera drifts past him onto the skyline.
SCENE 6 — EXT. PARIS BOULEVARD — DUSK — TWO YEARS LATER
A purple hypercar and the couple's dark luxury car stop side by side at a red light.
Through the luxury car's window, the girl glances over, bored, then gasps.
GIRL: Wha-
Nate at the wheel of the purple hypercar ignores her with a tiny smile.
GIRL: Nate?!
Nate points up: his private jet crosses the sunset sky over Paris.
She flings her door open and leans out, the older man gaping behind her.
GIRL: Nate, please take me back.
GIRL: I shouldn't have left you.
Nate, in sunglasses, throws his head back, laughing at the wheel.
NATE: La la la, I can't hear you!
The hypercar launches, exhaust spitting flames past her as she stands alone in the street.
At the wheel, Nate turns to camera and holds up his phone.
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — on Nate's phone held to camera, the balance reads $1,280,000
NATE: Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.

cast.description: Late teens, tan skin, big brown eyes, thick brows, dark curly hair. Before: navy cap worn backwards, plain white tee, silver chain, black jeans, white sneakers. After: black suit over a black tee, silver chain and watch, cap backwards, sunglasses at the wheel.
Young woman, long blonde hair with a white flower clip, cream crop tee, wide-leg light jeans. Same look in every scene.
Late 40s, tall, square jaw, slicked-back brown hair, navy suit, big gold watch.
